About

Tooldeck is a growing collection of free utilities for everyday tasks: compressing images, formatting code, planning finances, writing and staying secure online.

Every tool runs locally in your browser. We do not upload your files or text, there are no accounts, and pages load fast on any device.

The site is funded by optional support from people who find it useful.
